description: This PHP class, 'FormatWithJobCategory', implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface and is designed to format entity values by retrieving and returning the name of a 'JobCategory' based on a given identifier. It interacts with the 'JobCategoryService' to fetch 'JobCategory' entities and extract their names, facilitating dynamic formatting of job category data within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: FormatWithJobCategory
classes.description: A class that formats a value into a job category name by fetching the category via its ID.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Retrieves the job category by ID and returns its name, or null if not found.

methods.name: getJobCategoryService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of JobCategoryService.
